sentences.text: It is further submitted that applicant and prosecutrix entered into wedlock and lived for considerable period of time but because of her age, she was recovered from household of applicant at Bihar where they were living in matrimonial fold.

He still intends to live with prosecutrix as couple and incidentally prosecutrix is blessed with a child,
therefore on this count also, applicant seeks release on bail so that he can look after his family.

3. Learned Government Advocate for the State opposed the prayer for bail and prayed for its dismissal.
4.
Learned counsel for the complainant affirm the fact that prosecutrix was earlier married to applicant and now she blessed with a girl child.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
6.

Considering the submissions and the peculiar social family development undertaken meanwhile whereby a girl child has been borne out of the relationship of applicant and prosecutrix, this Court intends to allow the application.

It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.

7. This order will remain operative subject to compliance of the following conditions by the applicant :-
1.
The applicant will comply with all the terms and conditions of the bond executed by him;
The applicant shall mark his presence on first Sunday of every month before Police Station concerned between 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. till conclusion of trial.
